proofs.text: Write a record whose test strength is 90 and build the brief for a high-risk rule; verify the brief reads 90 against a minimum of 50
Write a record with no test strength and render the brief; verify the rendering reads `Test strength: n/a`

rule_text: The test strength comes off the feature's latest record and is shown against the configured minimum, reading `n/a` when no engine measured one

tests.name: test_it_comes_off_the_latest_record

tests.body:
def test_no_engine_reads_as_n_a(self):
        made = Project()
        try:
            made.proofs()
            made.record(strength=None)
            rendered = brief_module.render_brief(build(made, 'RULE-2'))
            assert 'Test strength: n/a' in rendered
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_no_engine_reads_as_n_a
